temperatureScaling.reason: The published RandomForestClassifier returns a vote share from predict_proba. The joblib does not expose logits, so temperature scaling is not applied.

ocrScores.reason: EasyOCR box scores are not classifier probabilities. Platt scaling, isotonic regression, and temperature scaling are not fit on them.
